title: Discovery call summary — operations and data

businessGoals: Give terminal managers a shared exception queue
requirementsDiscussed: FleetAxis must synchronize route, driver, hazardous-load flag, and terminal exception code in near real time.
DockPulse sensor alerts should appear in the shared exception queue.
Operations requested five years of history for seasonal analysis.
Terminal managers expect mobile access during overnight shifts.
openQuestions: Does the standard FleetAxis connector expose hazardous-load flag and terminal exception code?
Who owns DockPulse and can provide an API specification?
Who is the day-to-day customer implementation owner?
content.successStatement: Inez described success as fewer manual reconciliations, but no baseline, target, measurement owner, or acceptance test was agreed.
